status: frozen research evaluation plan; not a probability release
purpose: Evaluate candidate anchoring on additional archived House races without fitting to their outcomes
selection: First public archive-index capture per district during November 8-10; no selection using final outcomes
anchor: Latest _deluxe forecast available in the verified September 24 pre-election archive
training: 2020 presidential count likelihood and 2016-to-2020 geographic variance; no 2022 outcome fitting
scope: Conditional D/R component only; two identified major-party candidates, complete district-part geography, reconciled dated counts and certified outcome control
quarantine: Source counts exceed certified candidate totals
Unsupported municipal or ranked-choice reporting geography
report: All eligible races and separately races not previously inspected
Equal-race Brier score, log loss, margin MAE and 80% interval coverage
Paired state-cluster bootstrap intervals; do not count districts within a state as independent
Reporting-stage cohorts and prior-competitive races (absolute frozen forecast margin at most 10 points)
False 95%-confidence forecasts and every quarantine reason
Comparison with frozen forecast candidate-win probabilities where identity and denominator reconcile
limitations: Retrospective race extension after inspecting 14 races; not independent-cycle preregistration
Archive timing may concentrate the sample late in counting
No parameter adjustment on the added cohort may be represented as held-out validation
Passing this study alone cannot authorize all-candidate, runoff or ranked-choice odds
